text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes, thinking back on it, last autumn...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
At Tokyo Racecourse, the Condor who knew no defeat
was brought crashing down to earth...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
To that Umamusume, one of the nation's strongest,
the unstoppable frontrunner, Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, those broken wings were revived!
By the rallying cries of her best friend, the love of her mentor,
and her own indomitable fighting spirit!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The time to seize the throne has come!
Now, let us claim our revenge at the Takarazuka Kinen,
Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai—
I'm in your care todaaay!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What we could do! What we couldn't do!
We gave it everything we had.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I got crushed at the Fan Appreciation Festival, too...
There might not be a single thing I'm better at.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat you! If I don't win,
I'll never be able to aim for the world stage again!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To this vast sky, to this great crowd, I swear our grand victory!
(Oooooooooooo!)

El Condor Pasa's declaration of victory fires up the venue.
Even more so than back during the Mainichi Okan—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Ciao! Well then!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: There's nothing... I can beat them at...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's not true, El-san...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"You have it.
A power I don't know, a power I don't possess..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because you—can "change."
Through the voices of others.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival...
On that day, you stood back up time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spurred on by their cheers, gaining new strength every time I get back up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the fans.
So many of our friends, too...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you've come all this way
carrying those feelings on your shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She might just force her way into my field of view.
The only one among all the girls running today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't let you get in my way.
Leave me be."
